changelog: Universal Multi-Attachment Everywhere: Attach multiple receipts, deeds, agreements, IOUs, and passbooks to every Transaction, Asset, Liability, Savings Goal, People Ledger Entry, and Account.

Central Document & Attachment Hub: Sovereign encrypted file manager with pre-built system folders (Receipts, Deeds, Loans, People, Bank, Tax, Unfiled) and custom folders with custom colors and emoji icons.

Two-Tier Split-Payload Storage: Sub-second vault unlock (< 50ms) and ultra-low RAM footprint (< 30MB) across 1,000+ attachments by separating searchable metadata from heavy binary blobs (lazy-loaded on demand).
Dual-Directional Entity Linking: Attach files inside any modal or link/unlink existing files across multiple entries directly from the Document Hub.
Smart Optimized vs. Original RAW: Toggle between smart client-side 1080p compression and bit-exact uncompressed raw file storage.
Sub-5ms Instant Search & Filter: High-speed full-text search across attachment names, notes, and tags with entity filters and dual view modes (Visual Gallery Grid & Dense List Table).
Interactive Lightbox Document Viewer: Preview images and PDFs with smooth pan/zoom, 90-degree rotation, folder mover, and sovereign export.
Hero Card Real-Time Reactivity: Instant live balance calculations down to the single paisa for every entry without freezing.
First-Class Asset Redemption & Debt Payoff: Dedicated redemption tab with NAV calculations and one-click loan payoffs.
Android In-Place Update Fix: Continuous release signatures (v1, v2, v3) with persistent keystore ensuring seamless updates over existing installations.
